changelog: Initial release: diagnose Results sections of psychology/STEMM papers for claim-hedging alignment, causal language appropriateness, interpretation boundaries, and subjective language, with 1-5 scoring across 5 dimensions, grounded in 18 examples from 8 classic psychology papers.
summary: Academic writing revision advisor for the Results section of psychology and STEMM research papers. Checks claim-hedging alignment, causal language appropriateness, statistical reporting completeness, and interpretation boundaries. Triggers when the user asks to review, revise, or check a Results section draft, or mentions hedging, claim strength, overclaiming, or causal language in academic writing.
